_about: v79.10.3 (C2): the event an alternative qualification must fit (src/rag/lawyer_method.py:event_of, event_mismatch). The certain facts (the case's sentences narrated as fact, issue_records.certain_fact) are read for each event's patterns, in this order; an event listed in another's «unless» is not read when that one is (injuries with a death are the death's). The event's «unfit» families are never offered as a riqualificazione (thesis_candidates; the counter requalify_event_mismatch, must be 0, and requalify_refused_event); its «fits» families are. A family is a list of c.p. article numbers; an article in no family (586, 588, 593 …: a death or an injury alike) fits any event. «not_events» are the wordings that name the event without its having happened (a threat of death, a danger, an attempt) and are cut out of the sentence before the patterns are read. The table is Code's draft, for the lawyer's review. (review) «background_deaths»: a death dated by its year alone (named group «year»), earlier than the latest year the certain facts state, is the story's background and no event (lawyer_method.event_of).
